electile dysfunction.definition:
The inability to become aroused over any of the choices for President put forth by either party during an election year.\r
\r

> "Is anyone appealing to you in this years presidential race?"
> "Naa... No one excites me. I think I'm suffering from Electile Dysfunction."

electing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Elect
electing.translation: v. （进行）选举( elect的现在分词 ); 推举; 选择; 决定（做某事）

election.definition:
n. a vote to select the winner of a position or political office
n. the act of selecting someone or something; the exercise of deliberate choice
n. the status or fact of being elected
n. the predestination of some individuals as objects of divine mercy (especially as conceived by Calvinists)
election.translation:
n. 选举, 当选, 选择权
[法] 选举, 当选

election day.translation: [法] 选举日, 总统及国会议员选举日

election hangover.definition:
The feeling you have the day after an election, because you stayed up late trying to find out the results.
> Trevor: I have so much work to do, but I have an election hangover and can't get anything done!

election judge.translation: [法] 审理选区选举案件的法官
